Приложение использует сторонние сервисы, которые могут собирать информацию, используемую для вашей идентификации.

  • Firebase Analytics — для анонимной статистики использования приложения (например, количество запусков, переходов по экранам и т.п.).

3. Безопасность

Приложение Wondary и сайт wondary.digital не обрабатывают и не хранит персональные данные пользователей. Основной функционал приложения работает без подключения к интернету, а сайт выполняет исключительно информационную функцию.

Автоматически собираемая техническая информация (например, сведения об ошибках и статистика использования) обрабатывается сторонними сервисами Firebase (Analytics и Crashlytics), предоставляемыми компанией Google. Эти сервисы применяют современные технические и организационные меры защиты, включая шифрование данных, проверку подлинности и управление доступом.

Поскольку обработка персональных данных напрямую не осуществляется, риск несанкционированного доступа к информации минимален.

Last updated: April 12, 2025

This page is intended to inform visitors about the privacy policy applicable to the Wondary mobile application and the wondary.digital website, including the procedures for collecting, using, and disclosing information.

By using the application or visiting the website, the user agrees to the terms of this policy. Personal information, if any, may be used solely for the purpose of operating and improving the services. Such information is not shared with third parties, except as provided in this privacy policy.

1. Scope

This privacy policy applies to:

  • The Wondary mobile application (Android).
  • The wondary.digital website, which serves as an informational resource about the application and a host for this policy.
2. Data Collection and Use

Wondary App:

To improve user experience, the service may require providing certain personal information. Any such information is stored only on the user's device and is not transmitted to the developer.

The application uses third-party services that may collect information used to identify users.

  • Firebase Analytics – for anonymous usage statistics (e.g., number of launches, screen transitions, etc.).
  • Firebase Crashlytics – for tracking and resolving errors.

These services may collect technical information such as device type, OS version, device model, and general user behavior within the app. All data is collected anonymously and is not used to identify the user.

For more information on how Google processes data, visit: https://policies.google.com/privacy

wondary.digital Website:

The website does not collect or process any personal data, does not use cookies, and does not include contact forms.

3. Security

The Wondary application and the wondary.digital website do not process or store personal user data. The core functionality of the application works without an internet connection, and the website serves only informational purposes.

Automatically collected technical information (e.g., crash reports and usage statistics) is processed by third-party Firebase services (Analytics and Crashlytics) provided by Google. These services apply modern technical and organizational measures to protect information, including data encryption, authentication, and access control.

Since personal data is not directly processed, the risk of unauthorized access is minimal.

4. Children's Personal Data

The service is not intended for individuals who have not reached the age of full legal capacity according to the laws of their country of citizenship. Personal data of such individuals is not collected or processed without the consent of their legal representative.

5. Contact Information

For any questions or suggestions regarding privacy, please contact the developer by email at: support@wondary.digital

6. Policy Changes

This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. All changes will be published on this site with an updated effective date. It is recommended to review this page periodically for the most current version.
